message.content: Confirmed the fuzzer report — controller force exceeds its limit at step 111. I'll shrink the failing case to its minimal form and start the triage.
Shrink isolated the core failure. I'll replay it and inspect the state around the violation to determine the root cause.

At the failure point I found the controlled vehicle colliding with another body while the reported force suddenly exceeds the limit. That suggests the force capping breaks during collision handling. I'll verify this with a counterfactual test.
The limit breach is tied to the collision — increasing the force limit clears the violation. I'll finalize the triage report with the evidence.
